source: our own run of MMSA's code (THUIAR, MIT), not a published table
why: MMSA's results/result-stat.md covers none of these three models, so no published MMSA number exists to compare against. Running its code ourselves is the closest available reference, and a stronger one: it carries variance, so the comparison is distribution against distribution rather than against a single value.
how: scripts run under an isolated transformers 4.44 tree (MMSA's copies cannot import under transformers 5), same CUDA torch, same MOSI pickles our runs read, MMSA's own default hyper-parameters, seeds 42-51. Nothing in MMSA was edited; the accommodations are device plumbing and the feature path, both outside the algorithm.
caveat: These are MMSA's numbers for MMSA's implementation. Where MMSA departs from the original paper, this reference inherits the departure — see rule 5 in CLAUDE.md. Each model still needs its own paper comparison in docs/paper_reference_mosi.json.
